biotools.summary: PESSA is a web tool for performing survival analysis in cancer using gene set activation levels derived from ssGSEA. It allows users to analyze datasets from GEO, TCGA, EGA, and supplementary tables, offering Kaplan-Meier analyses and Cox regression analyses.
